{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The foundation of the democratic republic is a commitment to conducting free and fair elections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many African Americans, Hispanics, and others fear they may lose the right to vote because of inaccurate or insecure technology or because of a rolling back in the gains made by the passage of civil rights legislation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The national commitment to a voting process that has integrity was underscored in 2002 when Congress passed and the President signed the Help America Vote Act (HAVA).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to do all that can be done to ensure that every lawful vote counts for all Americans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for the New Freedom Initiative, President Bush's plan for fully integrating Americans with disabilities into all aspects of American life.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The New Freedom Initiative is helping Americans with disabilities by increasing access to assistive technologies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The New Freedom Initiative is expanding educational opportunities for Americans with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The New Freedom Initiative is increasing the ability of Americans with disabilities to integrate into the workforce.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The New Freedom Initiative is promoting increased access into daily community life for Americans with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"These are strong efforts to help Americans with disabilities lead independent, fulfilling lives.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
